events.event_name: Thomas & Friends: Railway Stories High Line Pop-Up
events.address: The High Line, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: Mattel's launch celebration for Thomas & Friends: Railway Stories, with a life-size Thomas character train, immersive branded displays, a special premiere screening, photo opportunities and children's activities.
events.what_is_free: Admission is free for all fans; the official announcement also promises complimentary refreshments and snacks.
events.caveats: Mattel's announcement says admission is free for all fans and does not publish an advance RSVP requirement. The announcement identifies the venue only as the High Line; a more specific entrance/location was not established in the sources reviewed, so it is not guessed here.
events.practical_notes: Friday Oct. 2, 5–7 PM at the High Line. Free public launch experience with life-size Thomas, screening, snacks and photo opportunities.

occurrences.details: Free admission for all fans; no advance RSVP requirement is published in Mattel's launch announcement.
